description: This file declares the OCIContainerImplementation class, which implements container management functionalities such as starting, stopping, and querying containers, as well as handling container events. It also defines an internal Job class for dispatching asynchronous tasks related to container events.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: Implements container lifecycle management and event handling, including registration, listing, starting, stopping, and querying container states. Also manages event notifications and dispatches container-related events.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation::Job
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous job for dispatching container event notifications, encapsulating event type and parameters, and providing a dispatch method.
